name: Perfect Eau de Toilette
editorialDescription: A lighter companion to Marc Jacobs' Perfect eau de parfum, in a pale-green bottle with charm-covered cap. Sephora describes it as white florals and cedarwood and lists pink peppercorn, polygonum and cedarwood as key notes; Ulta lists white daffodil as the heart. It's a cleaner, less fruity choice than the Daisy family.
keyFeatures: Concentration: eau de toilette (Perfect is also sold as an eau de parfum and Perfect Intense — check which you're buying)
advantages: A good contrast to the Daisy line if you want white florals and wood rather than fruit
Also sold as a travel spray, which is a lower-commitment way to try it
disadvantages: Three versions share the Perfect name, which makes it easy to order the wrong one
Concentration labels aren't standardized, so wear time varies
suits: People who prefer clean, woody florals to sweet or fruity scents
Shoppers comparing the Perfect line who want the lighter version
skipIf: You react to fragranced products or have fragrance allergy; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You want to smell it on your own skin before committing to a full bottle; look for a travel spray, mini or sample first
buyingConsiderations: Confirm 'Eau de Toilette' in the listing title; the EDP and Intense look similar
Prefer listings sold by the brand or Amazon
